DitherAurora.color: The bright lower edge of each curtain.
DitherAurora.tip-color: The faint tops of the rays, for a two-tone sky.
DitherAurora.edge-height: Where the lowest bright edge hangs, 0 (bottom) to 1 (top).
DitherAurora.sway: How far the edges fold, 0 to 3.
DitherAurora.turbulence: Fine ripples along the edges, 0 to 2.
DitherAurora.rays: How many rays fit across, 2 to 20.
DitherAurora.length: How far the rays reach, 0 to 1.
DitherAurora.glow: Brightness of the edge line, 0 to 2.
DitherAurora.scale: Horizontal zoom: higher fits more folds across.
DitherAurora.direction: up: rays rise from a bright lower edge. down: they hang from the top.
DitherAurora.mask: Fade it out where text sits: none, top, bottom or edges.
